mapper.sql: SELECT oi.book_id AS book_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sold FROM order_items oi INNER JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id AND o.order_status = 1 GROUP BY oi.book_id
mapper.select: SELECT 'TITLE' AS `type`, b.title AS text, b.isbn AS isbn, CAST(COALESCE(s.sold, 0) AS SIGNED) AS hot FROM books b LEFT JOIN () s ON s.book_id = b.id WHERE b.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') ORDER BY hot DESC, b.title ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT 'AUTHOR' AS `type`, b.author AS text, NULL AS isbn, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(s.sold), 0) AS SIGNED) AS hot FROM books b LEFT JOIN () s ON s.book_id = b.id WHERE b.author LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') GROUP BY b.author ORDER BY hot DESC, b.author ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT 'ISBN' AS `type`, b.isbn AS text, b.isbn AS isbn, CAST(COALESCE(s.sold, 0) AS SIGNED) AS hot FROM books b LEFT JOIN () s ON s.book_id = b.id WHERE b.isbn LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') ORDER BY hot DESC, b.isbn ASC LIMIT #{limit}
